result.topic_en: Notes on the attraction of a uniformly distributed agent (electricity) on a plane: the x-component of force from the first system, and a decomposition of the plane into elementary sectors with vertex at the foot of the perpendicular, to derive a general theorem on the force at a point at distance x from the plane.
result.transcription:
